findings.summary: ADR 0031 Consequences said the unavailable-verifier outcome.reported stays as it is, while the §3 table adds action_state null; ADR wording fixed.
The D7 projection compares what the frozen Phase 2 golden format records (types, key sets, states, digest), not every payload value byte for byte.
No reconstruction scenario for the DuplicateOperation block branch or for startup recovery blocking several actions.
Neither golden run asks for input, so the accept_input remap in phase2_projection is not exercised; the ERP mutation test has 1 case to the kernel's 5.
